templates.title: Opening (warm)
templates.when_used: Opens every composed reply to a post-review appeal.
templates.body: We understand that this outcome may be disappointing, and we appreciate the effort you invested in preparing your submission.

templates.title: Lead-in to the numbered points
templates.when_used: Introduces the numbered points in a composed reply.
templates.body: We would like to respond to your concerns:

templates.title: Point: SPCs weighed the paper and every review together
templates.when_used: Every merged reply: the author disputes the scores, a review, the record, or a reviewer's conduct.
templates.body: Decisions are not based on any single review or on the visible scores alone. SPCs evaluated both the paper and the reviews, and all assessments were weighed together.

templates.title: Point: senior program committee members evaluated paper and reviews
templates.when_used: The author claims reviewer misconduct, or that a reviewer called something missing that the author says was submitted.
templates.body: Decisions are not based on any single review. Senior program committee members evaluated both the paper and the reviews to decide their recommendation.

lint_waivers.note: Marc's approved misconduct point 1 (2026-10-05) names senior program committee members

templates.title: Point: unprofessional reviewers are reported and tracked
templates.when_used: The author claims a reviewer was unprofessional, hostile, made unfounded accusations or breached confidentiality.
templates.body: We ask SPCs and ACs to report reviewers who are unprofessional. We keep track of reviewers' performance and take it into account in future editions.

lint_waivers.note: The chairs' wording (2026-10-06) names SPCs and ACs

templates.title: Point: report unethical behavior through the ethics form
templates.when_used: The author claims reviewer misconduct; tells them how to report it without changing the outcome.
templates.body: You can also report unethical behavior through the ethics report form at https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdIs72RunUy5wKsOv7SdBma6A6riv3jp8lifUxlLcwhcdXMxw/viewform. This may impact our future relationship with this reviewer, but it will not change the outcome for this specific paper.

templates.title: Point: scores are not the whole decision
templates.when_used: The author argues the scores do not support the rejection.
templates.body: SPCs also considered whether the concerns raised could be addressed with minor clarifications or would require substantial revision.

templates.title: Point: no single review decides
templates.when_used: The author argues a reviewer misread, misunderstood or did not read the paper.
templates.body: Decisions are not based on any single review; all assessments are weighed together.

templates.title: Point: no rebuttal in the two-phase process
templates.when_used: The author disputes the scores or a review and had no chance to respond.
templates.body: AAAI's two-phase process forgoes rebuttal for Phase 1 papers in favor of a quicker decision. We understand this can be frustrating.

templates.title: Point: input considered for future editions
templates.when_used: The author criticizes the quality of a review.
templates.body: Thank you for sharing your view of the review process. We will consider your input when studying possible changes for future editions.

templates.title: Point: the identified AI-generated review
templates.when_used: The author claims a review was written by an LLM or other AI tool.
templates.body: The review process includes one review that is clearly identified as AI-generated. It carries no ratings and plays no part in the decision.

templates.title: Point: report a review through the ethics form
templates.when_used: The author believes a review breaks the reviewing policies or ethical guidelines.
templates.body: If you believe a review violates the reviewing policies or ethical guidelines, you can report it through the form at [ETHICS FORM ADDRESS].

templates.title: Closing (reviewed papers)
templates.when_used: Closes a composed reply to a paper that was reviewed.
templates.body: The decision is final, but we hope the feedback will be useful in further strengthening your work and helping you secure publication in another leading venue or future AAAI edition. Thank you for raising your concerns; we will document them and help improve the future AAAI editions.

templates.title: Holding reply: wrong-paper review
templates.when_used: The author claims a review discusses a different paper, and the chair will look into it.
templates.body: Thank you for flagging this. We will investigate and follow up with you.

templates.title: Holding reply: scores vs outcome
templates.when_used: The author argues the scores do not support the rejection, and the chair will look into it.
templates.body: Thank you for flagging your concern about the consistency of the outcome. We will investigate and follow up with you.

templates.title: Holding reply: wrong-paper review and scores
templates.when_used: The author raises both a wrong-paper review and a scores concern, and the chair will look into them.
templates.body: Thank you for flagging these concerns. We will investigate and follow up with you.

templates.title: Reconsideration request (no specific ground)
templates.when_used: The author objects to the decision without a specific ground and asks for reconsideration.
templates.body: We understand your wish for the decision to be reconsidered. We also understand that not having a chance for rebuttal is frustrating, but this is how the two-phase process works.

templates.title: Chair writes the reply
templates.when_used: The author appeals on a ground no other block covers, so the chair writes the reply.
templates.body: [CHAIR: write reply]

templates.title: Reciprocal-review desk rejection (full reply)
templates.when_used: The paper was desk-rejected because its nominated reciprocal reviewer did not complete their review.
templates.body:
We understand that this situation is disappointing, and we appreciate the effort you invested in preparing your submission. We would like to clarify the circumstances:

(1) Both the reciprocal reviewers and their coauthors were informed that failure to complete their assigned reviews could result in desk rejection of the paper(s) that nominated them.

(2) In your case, the nominated reciprocal reviewer did not complete their assigned review. The desk rejection is therefore consistent with the stated policy.

The desk rejection is final, but we hope to see your work at a future AAAI conference.

templates.title: General complaint about the review process (Yan's stage-1 reply)
templates.when_used: The author objects to the review or decision without a specific ground; used only when no other reason is raised.
templates.body:
Thank you for taking the time to share your concerns regarding the review process for your submission. We take concerns about fairness in the review process seriously and have carefully considered the issues you raised.

We understand that aspects of the reviews may have led you to feel that your submission did not receive fair consideration. We would like to emphasize that the final decision on a submission is not determined by any single review or reviewer.

To further strengthen the consistency and fairness of the decision-making process, we have introduced a new SPC buddy system. Under this system, each SPC is paired with another SPC who serves as a "buddy" and independently reviews the SPC's recommendations. This additional layer of cross-checking is intended to reduce the influence of any individual assessment and promote greater consistency and fairness across the review process. In addition, the Area Chair is asked to review the recommendations by SPCs. When concerns arise regarding the quality of a particular review, these concerns are taken into account when the reviews are weighed as part of the overall assessment.

Your feedback is valuable to us, not only in reviewing the process surrounding your submission but also in identifying areas where the review process can be improved. We will document the concerns raised and share relevant information with future AAAI Program Chairs to support continued improvements in the quality, fairness, and integrity of the review process. We appreciate your engagement with the process and your effort in bringing these concerns to our attention.

lint_waivers.note: The chairs' wording (2026-10-06) names the SPC and Area Chair roles

templates.title: Complaint about an AI-generated review (Yan's reply)
templates.when_used: The author claims a review was written by an LLM or other AI tool; used only when no other reason is raised.
templates.body:
Thank you for providing the detailed information regarding your concerns about the reviews of your submission. We take concerns about the integrity and quality of the review process seriously and have carefully considered the issues you raised.

We recognize that some characteristics of a review may raise concerns about the possible use of AI tools. But rest assured that the decision on your submission does not rely on any single review. The SPC and/or Area Chair have also reviewed the paper, considered the reviews, and formed their own assessment of the submission. The final decision is made based on this broader evaluation rather than on the assessment or recommendation of any individual reviewer.

In addition, we ask SPCs to assess the quality of the reviews and provide feedback on the reviewers, including identifying reviews that exhibit characteristics associated with AI-generated content. Your feedback is also very valuable to us. We will document these concerns and share the relevant information with future AAAI Program Chairs to help further improve the quality and integrity of the review process.

Thank you again for raising your concerns and for providing the supporting details. We appreciate your engagement with the review process.

lint_waivers.note: The chairs' wording (2026-10-06) names the SPC and Area Chair roles
